lastCompletedStory.title: Close the shipped-tree gap: full-path KNOWN_MISSING for scripts/cam/handoff.json + shipped-tree regression test

nextStoryContext: US-R2-002 closed the last round-2 gap: added a full-path KNOWN_MISSING entry for scripts/cam/handoff.json (mirroring the existing scripts/cam/prd.json entry, reasoning it is per-branch harness state git-rm'd by ship-finalize's harnessPaths and cited by full path in .claude/agents/*.md, so it never resolves on the shipped/main tree). This was the exact defect class the round-2 reviewer flagged as latent: findKnownMissingMatch is Bun.Glob-based and the pre-existing bare-filename entry 'handoff.json' does not match the full-path claim 'scripts/cam/handoff.json'. Added a new regression describe block in test/validate-agents-md.test.ts that builds a REAL shipped-tree snapshot (not a synthetic fixture): `git archive HEAD` piped into a fresh temp dir, then deletes the 3 ship-finalize harnessPaths (scripts/cam/prd.json, scripts/cam/handoff.json, scripts/cam/progress.txt) from that extracted tree, re-inits a throwaway git repo there (`git init` + `git add -A`) so `git ls-files`/`git check-ignore` reflect the shipped state, then runs the real validateDocs() (real COMMANDS from index.ts, real bunScripts from the snapshot's own package.json, real KNOWN_MISSING) against it and asserts zero path-kind findings. Manually verified the test fails (6 path findings) when the AC1 entry is reverted, and passes once it's present -- confirming it is a true regression guard, not a tautology. Root-caused and fixed a genuine flake risk while building this: `spawnSync('git', ['archive', 'HEAD'], { cwd })` piped into `spawnSync('tar', ['-x'], { input })` silently truncates this repo's ~8.6MB archive under node:child_process's default 1MB maxBuffer -- the truncation throws no error on the archive call itself, it only surfaces later as a tar 'Truncated tar archive' error and then as a wall of hundreds of unrelated-looking path-claim findings (extracted tree missing most files). Fixed by passing an explicit `maxBuffer: 1024 * 1024 * 200` on the git archive spawn; documented as a patterns.md bullet so a future story piping large git-archive output doesn't rediscover this the hard way. `bun run check:all` (all 12 gates green: test, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, typecheck) and `bun test` (4518 pass / 0 fail) are green. Did not touch prd.json (pre-existing working-tree modification from the supervisor's story insertion, not authored by this story). Check prd.json for the next story; if none remain (besides operator-required), the PRD is complete.
